title: Excavations in Palestine in 1931-2: Umm ez Zuweitina
author: (round-up; work directed by R. Neuville)
screen_term: Umm ez Zuweitina, south of Wadi Khureitun (spelling of gazetteer 'khareitun')
location_note: Cave south of Wadi Khureitun; no map reference; placed by name (gazetteer zone of Khareitun). Not a held cave area.
notes: July 1932 sounding at the cave entrance: Lower Natufian hearth with a limestone animal statuette and Natufian tools under modern black earth.

features.subtype: cave with Lower Natufian hearth at the entrance
features.quote: At the entrance of the cave a Lower Natufian hearth was found
